name: offline-sale

description.en: A room tablet with no network sells QA Water for cash: priced locally from the cached menu (the pricer's rule, pinned by services/orders/offline_sale/parity.json), kept in IndexedDB and the outbox under the key minted at the tap, a receipt saying 'pa NIVF - do te fiskalizohet brenda 48 oreve'. On reconnect the outbox replays it exactly once into the venue's object as a PICKED_UP cash order with its original time; the fiscal queue holds it with a deadline 48 h from the sale; sending stays OFF (fiscal::SEND_ENABLED=false).
description.uk: Планшет залу без мережі продає QA Water за готівку; після підключення продаж потрапляє в хаб рівно один раз із часом продажу, а фіскальна черга тримає його зі строком 48 год від продажу; надсилання до податкової вимкнено.

producer.what: send(): POST /api/staff/offline_sales under Idempotency-Key = sale_key, or OUT.queue with the same key

consumer.what: sell(): staff_at(Cap::TakePayment) -> idempotency guard staff.offline_sale -> basket::ask -> room/offline_sync (hubdo/room/offline.rs)

external_note: No external API: the fiscal sender (eBills) is OFF by the platform switch fiscal::SEND_ENABLED=false (workers/api/src/fiscal/mod.rs:40); nothing on this path reaches the network (test sending_stays_off_and_nothing_on_the_offline_path_can_reach_the_network).

auth.how: the owner's token signs the room app (courier::staff_at accepts an owner token for Cap::TakePayment); no waiter credential is needed

schema_status: draft from the Rust types (offline_sale::SaleIn deny_unknown_fields, SyncOut, ledger::Pane); tighten from the first live answer
probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-offline-sale.mjs: Chromium on qa-durres /room/ signed with the owner token; context.setOffline(true); sell QA Water cash; the receipt shows 'pa NIVF'; reload OFFLINE (the room service worker serves the shell); setOffline(false); the sale lands ONCE in /api/owner/orders (offline:<key>, PICKED_UP, created_at_ms = sold_at); a direct replay under the same key answers replayed=true and still one order; /api/owner/offline_sales lists it with deadline = sold_at + 172800000; then the TEST sale is ended by the refund route.
run: node tools/live-proof/probes/feature-offline-sale.mjs   (LIVE_HOST defaults to https://qa-durres.dowiz.org; a non-qa host is refused by e2e/flows/lib.mjs)
